trigger: First review under RBM-004. Subject: Modine Manufacturing (MOD), chosen because its filing history is known to contain twenty spans filed at more than one value and two concepts that changed XBRL tag. A profile whose gates are about restatement and tag drift should be first pointed at a filer that has both, so a null result would mean the gates do not work rather than that the subject is clean.
tier_rationale: The subject is a position-sized holding and the review reads a full reported history rather than a single figure, which is Tier 2 under RBM-004 section 8. Tier 3 is not claimed: SG-04 and SG-05 are unreached, and claiming a tier the evidence does not support is the defect the predecessor crypto review was re-run to correct.

omitted_roles.justification: SG-04 is unreached in this review: control and related-party disclosure is narrative text in the 10-K body and the proxy statement, and the connector reads XBRL only. A seat with no evidence to read would produce a report that looked like an assessment, which is worse than an omission recorded here.
SG-05 is unreached in this review: exit liquidity for a listed equity needs traded volume and depth, and no market data source is configured. Recorded as an omission for the same reason as CRA.
